appDescription: An app to compute and visualize descriptive statistics for your data sets: discrete, continuous, and qualitative variables.
bulkImportHint: One row per line. Separate values with a semicolon ( ; ) or a tab.
bulkImportInvalidFormat: Invalid format. Each line must contain:
rawSeriesNumericHint: Type or paste the observed values and the app counts the frequencies. Separate them with spaces, semicolons or line breaks (e.g. 3 5 5 7 3). A comma is read as a decimal separator: 2,5.
rawSeriesQualitativeHint: Type or paste the observed modalities and the app counts the frequencies. One per line, or separated by commas or semicolons (e.g. Red; Blue; Red).
rawSeriesInvalidValue: Unrecognized value: "$value". Separate values with spaces or semicolons.
connectionErrorContent: Unable to update data from server
tutoStep1: 1. Insert the study data line by line (a comma is accepted as the decimal separator), or paste several lines at once
tutoStep2: 2. Select the statistical criteria to be studied
tutoStep4: 4. Save your study for future access, or export your backups to carry them to another device
discreteChartTypesSummary: change the graphical representation of discrete variables
continuousChartTypesSummary: change the graphical representation of continuous variables
qualitativeChartTypesSummary: change the graphical representation of qualitative variables
calcVarD: Calculate a statistical series with discrete quantitative variables
noChartTypeSelected: No chart type selected. Change this in Settings.
invalidValueError: Invalid values: frequencies must be positive, and their sum cannot be zero!
backupsImportInvalidFormat: Invalid file: these backups could not be imported.
multipleModesNote: This series has no unique mode: multiple values are tied for the highest frequency.
quantileConventionNote: Convention used: the value kept is the first one whose cumulative frequency is strictly above the threshold. Some courses instead take, when the cumulative frequency lands exactly on the threshold, the average of that value and the next one.
quantileExactTieNote: Here the cumulative frequency lands exactly on the threshold: with the other convention, you would get $name = $value.
overlappingClassesError: The classes overlap: each class must start after the previous one ends.
unequalWidthsModeNote: The classes don't all have the same width: the modal class and N0, N1, N2 are taken from the adjusted frequencies (densities di = Ni / k) instead of the frequencies.
quantileInterpolationLabel: Linear interpolation within the class where the cumulative frequency goes above
modeExplanationD: The mode is equal to the variable with the highest frequency
medianExplanationD: The median is equal to the variable with the cumulative relative frequency directly above
firstQuartExplanationD: The first quartile is equal to the variable with the cumulative relative frequency directly above
thirdQuartExplanationD: The third quartile is equal to the variable with the cumulative relative frequency directly above
firstDecileExplanationD: The first decile is equal to the variable with the cumulative relative frequency directly above
ninthDecileExplanationD: The ninth decile is equal to the variable with the cumulative relative frequency directly above
calcVarC: Calculate a statistical series with continuous quantitative variables
calcVarN: Calculate a statistical series with nominal or ordinal qualitative variables
qltMode: The mode is the modality with the largest number of frequency
